scientific_integrity: Complete symbolic proof, explicit complete-return classification, and standalone finite sanity checker. Finite tests are not substitutes for the all-length proof.
scientific_limitations: Binary linear words of exact Hamming weight two; counting distinct nonempty closed factors. Does not solve unrestricted binary extremal closed-factor complexity. Priority not independently certified, and full 2016 closed-factorization paper was inaccessible.
title: Sharp closed-factor complexity with exactly two marked positions
